posts.topic: The Efficiency Gap Is Now a CFO Problem
posts.hook: Workloads up 10%. Budgets up 1%. The efficiency gap that closes by automation, not effort.
posts.visual_direction: Dominant 9% metric in teal on deep purple. Hook reinforces the workload vs budget tension for CFOs.
posts.key_stat: Procurement workloads rising 10% vs 1% budget increase. Advanced platforms deliver 15-20% cost savings and 40% faster cycle times.
posts.source: The Hackett Group 2025 Key Issues Study; Top 10 Procurement Trends 2026
